sources.publisher: Embassy of Brazil in Kingston (2027 selection guide, hosted by the Ministry of Finance of Jamaica)
sources.note: States that there are places in courses in all areas of knowledge, and that the list of institutions and courses (field, degree type, campus, intake semester, places) is published on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs selection page

sources.publisher: Ministry of Education of Brazil (SESu/MEC), Public Notice 1/2025 for the 2026 intake, English translation hosted by the State University of Ceara
sources.note: Previous cycle: confirms the list of institutions and courses is published on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs selection page, and that places are complete classroom undergraduate courses

subject_rule: The Embassy of Brazil guide says there are "placements in courses in all areas of knowledge, with no fees or entrance exams"; the courses you can actually choose are those the participating institutions list each year.
notes: No courses recorded: the official list of participating institutions and courses for the 2027 selection could not be read (see fetch problems), so the stored general description stays the only programme information.

The 2027 notice (Public Notice 22 of 25 March 2026) allows up to 700 places shared between PEC-PLE (2027) and PEC-G (2028) and up to 700 places only for PEC-G entering in 2027, as a summary of the notice states; the course list per institution is a separate publication.
Degree types as the guide explains them: bacharelado (4 to 5 years, sometimes 6), licenciatura (about 4 years) and tecnologo (2 to 3 years).
not_stated: The courses and institutions of the 2027 selection in any document that could be read
fetch_problems: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs selection page (Portuguese and English versions) shows a human-verification image challenge instead of the page, so the course list was not read. The check was not attempted.
The 2027 notice PDF on the Ministry of Education site returned the same kind of access-interrupted page, so its text and any annex were not read.
No other official copy of the 2027 course list (embassy, ministry or university page) was found.
